sloka: तस्मिन्सन्ध्यामुपासित्वा स्नात्वा जप्त्वा च वानरः ।उत्तरं सागरं प्रायाद्वहमानो दशाननम् ।। ७.३४.२९ ॥
transliteration: tasminsandhyāmupāsitvā snātvā japtvā ca vānaraḥ ।uttaraṁ sāgaraṁ prāyādvahamāno daśānanam ।। 7.34.29 ॥

translations.english: Having performed his evening prayers, bathed, and chanted mantras there, Vali, the monkey, proceeded to the northern ocean, still carrying Ravana.
